name: mahi-backpressure-threshold-restore

base_results.finding: current clean live reference after nginx isolation
65,536-item observer relay queue bound produced controlled retries under the normal 100k/60s topology

hypothesis: Item 253 proved the backpressure path works but its live threshold was too low. Raising observer relay and pre-admitted backpressure thresholds to the hard Mahi pre-admitted pool size should restore item-251-class zero-error throughput while retaining client-visible retry before unbounded overload.

planned_config.rationale: Match the hard Mahi pre-admitted pool capacity so normal green-topology burst buffering does not become premature RPC retry.

planned_live_steps.description: build release binary natively for Linux from the tagged experiment commit
deploy default three-ingress topology with restored thresholds
wipe state and restart default live topology
planned_live_steps.command: cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) .venv/bin/ansible kombat_live_testnet -m shell -a 'systemctl stop kombat-chain-ingress3 kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain && rm -rf /var/lib/and-chain && mkdir -p /var/lib/and-chain/snapshots && chown -R and-chain:and-chain /var/lib/and-chain && systemctl start kombat-chain && systemctl start kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress3'

success_criteria.rollback_if_miss: If zero-error item-251-class throughput does not return, revert the item253 runtime behavior and redeploy the item251 binary/config before further protocol work.

result.reason: Raising thresholds removed item253's client-visible retries, but the item253 runtime behavior still collapsed committed TPS and left large post-drain Mahi pre-admitted backlogs. This fails the green recovery gate.
result.next_move: Revert the item253 runtime behavior and redeploy the item251-style binary/config before further protocol work.
